text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Zimbabwean government on Tuesday night dissolved the Zimbabwe Electricity Supply Authority (ZESA) board following recent media reports of the board's disapproval of a near-equal partnership between government and a Malaysian company, YTL, for the privatisation of ZESA's Hwange Thermal Power Station.

- Ex-Rhodesian Selous Scout lieutenant Anthony White, implicated in the 1986 murder of Swedish prime minister Olaf Palme, is still wanted for questioning in Zimbabwe over his possible involvement in illegal ivory trade and black rhino poaching.
- Zimbabwe's wheat consumption has gone up to an estimated 500,000 tonnes a year, creating a shortfall of 220,000 tonnes.
